  agent/lib/donn/config.ts
    // Generated by donn; edit the persona, not this file.
    import { wrapLanguageModel, type LanguageModelMiddleware } from "ai";
    import { missingEnv } from "./env";
    import { anthropic } from "eve/models/anthropic";
    
    const base = anthropic("claude-sonnet-5");
    
    // eve builds the agent without the run-time environment, so a missing variable fails
    // here, at the first model call, naming every one.
    const guard: LanguageModelMiddleware = {
      wrapGenerate: async ({ doGenerate }) => {
        refuseWhenMissing();
        return doGenerate();
      },
      wrapStream: async ({ doStream }) => {
        refuseWhenMissing();
        return doStream();
      },
    };
    function refuseWhenMissing(): void {
      const missing = missingEnv();
      if (missing.length > 0) {
        throw new Error(
          `donn: missing environment variables: ${missing.join(", ")}`,
        );
      }
    }
    const model =
      typeof base === "string"
        ? base
        : wrapLanguageModel({ model: base, middleware: guard });
    
    // eve accepts exactly these keys; `agent.ts` spreads this object into defineAgent.
    export const donn = {
      model,
    };
    
  agent/lib/donn/env.ts
    // Generated by donn; edit the persona, not this file.
    // The environment variables donn's generated files read. Loading this module only warns;
    // the agent's model refuses to run while any is missing (see config.ts).
    const values: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
    };
    
    export function missingEnv(): string[] {
      return Object.keys(values).filter((name) => values[name] === undefined);
    }
    
    const missing = missingEnv();
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      console.warn(`donn: missing environment variables: ${missing.join(", ")}`);
    }
    
  agent/lib/donn/route-auth.ts
    // Generated by donn; edit the persona, not this file.
    // The token is read per request, so `eve build` (which evaluates this module without the
    // run-time environment) never needs it.
    import { extractBearerToken, withAuthChallenges, type AuthFn } from "eve/channels/auth";
    
    export const donnToken: AuthFn<Request> = withAuthChallenges(
      (request) => {
        const expected = process.env.DONN_ROUTE_TOKEN;
        const token = extractBearerToken(request.headers.get("authorization"));
        if (!expected || !token || token !== expected) return null;
        return {
          attributes: {},
          authenticator: "donn",
          principalId: "donn-local",
          principalType: "service",
        };
      },
      [{ scheme: "Bearer" }],
    );
